about: The reviewed list of ADR 0027 and its Step 3 review notes: everything a conformance baseline (2025-11-25.yaml, 2026-07-28.yaml beside this file) may excuse, each with why. fixtureScenarios are whole scenarios that call the referee's own fixture tools, prompts, resources or capabilities, which the relay does not serve and should not. untestableChecks are single checks, in scenarios whose other checks must pass, that cannot reach the relay at all: the suite itself reports them "Not testable" for want of a tool the relay does not serve (notTestable gives the words after "Not testable: "), or they need a method of a capability the relay never declares, which it answers -32601 (unknownMethod); a run fails if one of them fails in any other words. shouldWarnings are single SHOULD-level checks; a run fails if one of them fails as anything but a warning. extensionScenarios are whole scenarios of an optional extension the relay does not offer, allowed only where the set itself runs them unscored as an extension. Nothing here may name dns-rebinding-protection, http-header-validation, server-session-lifecycle or any wire-schema-valid check, and every other MUST-level check must pass. test/conformance-baselines.test.ts holds both baselines to this list and this list to those rules, and src/conformance.ts holds each run to them; change it only in a reviewed commit.

shouldWarnings.server-stateless:sep-2575-server-sends-t: SHOULD notify a listen stream when the tool list changes; the suite changes the list through the referee's fixture, and the relay's own notifications are tested in packages/relay/test/page-tools-notify.test.ts and tests/e2e/test/revisions.test.ts
shouldWarnings.sep-2164-resource-not-found:sep-2164-err: SHOULD answer -32602 for a resource that does not exist; the relay serves no resources, so resources/read is an unknown method (-32601)
shouldWarnings.sep-2164-resource-not-found:sep-2164-dat: SHOULD name the missing resource's URI in the error; the relay serves no resources
shouldWarnings.input-required-result-ignore-extra-param: SHOULD ignore unrecognized inputResponses keys; the suite sends them to the referee's fixture tool test_input_required_result_elicitation
shouldWarnings.input-required-result-missing-input-resp: SHOULD re-request missing inputResponses; the suite asks it of the referee's fixture tool test_input_required_result_elicitation
shouldWarnings.server-sse-polling:server-sse-priming-ev: SHOULD prime a POST SSE stream with an event of an id and empty data, for a client to resume from (2025-11-25 transports); the relay keeps no event store, so its SDK transport offers no resumption and sends no priming event
shouldWarnings.server-sse-polling:server-sse-retry-fiel: SHOULD send a retry field before closing a connection whose stream has not ended (2025-11-25 transports); with no event store the relay offers no polling, so its SDK transport sends none
